dict.string: Lucid Ride records your motorcycle ride GPS track and links it to body-state telemetry.
Lucid Ride records your motorcycle ride GPS track in the background, so a phone screen-off ride still captures the route.
Lucid Ride connects to your bike's OBD adapter (OBDLink MX+) and to RaceBox / GoPro telemetry over Bluetooth.
Lucid Ride needs Bluetooth to connect to bike telemetry hardware.
Lucid Ride uses iPhone IMU as fallback lean-angle source when RaceBox isn't connected.
